svg.title: a flawless quantum computer, 1,024 shots
svg.desc: A flawless 8-qubit device sampling a uniform target: one simulated run of 1,024 shots (splitmix64, seed 0) as 256 bars against the ideal of 4 each, bars clipped at 4 times the ideal. This run scores 0.9334 and leaves 3 outcomes empty. The curve is shotfloor's closed form E[BC]², a lower bound on the mean Hellinger fidelity: 0.3807, 0.5986, 0.8056 at 128, 256, 512 shots; 0.9239 at 1,024 shots (0.92 at 1,024 on the curve); by that bound, shotfloor puts 0.95 at 1,425 shots; 1.0 only at infinite shots. The curve runs from 64 to 65,536 shots.
svg.text: bars: seed 0 run · curve: E[BC]² ≤ mean F
